steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: When was the last time you performed maintenance on your equipment?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's about time. You'd better get to work on them.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You still have that maintenance diagram I drew for you?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yup! I hung it up in my room.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Are there sufficient tools and consumables in that room? If you've run out, you can take some now.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Let's clean up and pack up. Then we can head out when the fire dies down.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Yes, I have to go check on the boiler room, then collect the materials I ordered from the warehouse  . Don't have time to worry about the fire.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That's not a good job   for you.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You have things you need to do as well, right?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I made you a lunch, remember to take it when you leave.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll come find you when I finish.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I'll go to my room to take care of my babies   then.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: This...  The picture   says vegetable oil.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Dip the cloth into the oil, then slowly rub all the shiny parts.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I wonder what Vulcan will say when she sees how good   I did? Maybe I'll get a gift?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: She made a top   for me last time. It's so fun to spin!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Maybe I'll get something even better this time.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Since it's food for my babies, it must taste good.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Ceobe dips her finger in the oil and licks it)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Looks like I can't eat the food my babies like.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: And here I thought maybe we'd have something to enjoy together.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Oh, I have to wipe oil on other parts.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Grilled meatbeast chop! And mashed potatoes with sauce!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan is so good at crafting anything, even food!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hm, what time is it now?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Oh, eleven... eleven fifteen... It's noon!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: It's time for everyone to eat!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Wow, there's a lot of people here!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Let's see what food they have.

steps.name: Courier
steps.text: Hello, Ceobe. What do you want to eat?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Since there's so much good food here, there must be more inside!)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Okay, let me think how to sneak inside.)

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Courier, the food for your counter is almost here. Be ready.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan taught me to watch closely and wait for a chance.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I didn't watch enough last time and the old guy caught me at the door...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: But this time will be different!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Shchi, huh? If I recall correctly, it goes there in the middle, where Courier is standing.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (The door is close to my hiding spot.)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (There's a pretty lady by the door, I can't let her see me.)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (There's a lot of tasty stuff next to her, but people are watching.)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (There's a little hole further away. I think it is for dishes. I can't get through it.)

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Wooaahh! Kay, you can't go in there!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: You can't! Don't you see the sign on the door?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I see a red circle with a tilty red line going through it.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: That means 'Kay is not allowed in here.' Got it?

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If you get it, why are you still going in?!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If you're hungry, you can just get in line and order something to eat.

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: Fine, fine! I'll think of something!!

steps.name: Gummy
steps.text: If I give you this cookie, will you promise not to go inside?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Sorry Little Cub, I still want to go in.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Maybe I got found out because I was too excited.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I won't make the same mistake again!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (The only one by the door is the pretty lady at the counter.)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Yummy yummy goodies, here I come!!

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: What is it? Where are you going?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (What do I do?! What do I do?!)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I-I want to go to the toilet.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: This isn't the toilet. There's a sign over there, look for the one with the blue and pink people.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: No problem, don't make the same mistake next time.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Ahh, I'm lucky she didn't figure me out. I don't want Vulcan to get mad at me.)

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Gitano, the last dish is here.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Ah, good job. This should go to the farthest corner where Noir Corne is.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Ooh, I didn't know you two were THAT close.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: Don't joke about it, it hurts.

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Put two standard meal sets at the prep station near the kitchen door.

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: If you're joking, doesn't that mean I'm done for...

steps.name: Gitano
steps.text: Go on, we can wrap up and have lunch soon.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: There's no one there at all.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Even the pretty lady by the door is gone.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Ohh! There really was food here!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Ah, I'm so happy I got to eat!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I better go home and finish taking care of my babies!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Just now, wasn't Little Cub's tummy rumbling?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Is she hungry because she gave her cookie to me?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan says that when people help you, you should pay it back double or triple or whatever's even more than those, I forgot! Fourple?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Anyway, Little Cub gave me a small cookie, so I should give her a really really really——big cookie.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Okay, I'll make it as soon as Vulcan gets back!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Now I need to go home and finish up my work.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: The covers for the weapons and the bag are clean.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan, please hurry back, so Little Cub won't be hungry anymore...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Ah, Vulcan! I'll get the door!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: You came back really early today.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Work went nice and smooth today, finished quick.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Can you let me see your maintenance work?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I just finished, the weapons are all neat on the table!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (I did it just like the pictures  .)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: The oil is applied very evenly.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: (Vulcan lifts the weapon and sniffs it)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'm going back to the workshop. Do you want to come along?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: This is a good batch of material here.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Hope I can make something satisfying out of it.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Go on, say it, say it! Little Cub is still starving!)

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: What's wrong? Is there anything you want to tell me?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Can you teach me how to make a big cookie?!

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Oh? You want to make your own food, finally?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Please, teach me quickly! Little Cub is gonna starve to death soon!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Noon... Yeah, noon! I saw Little Cub at noon!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: She gave me a really tasty cookie! So I want to give Little Cub an even bigger, even tastier one! But, I don't know how to make a cookie, and I don't know where Little Cub lives either, I-I——

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You'll twist your tongue in a knot if you keep talking.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Sorry... I-I'm in a bit of a hurry...

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll teach you how to make the treat, then bring you there.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'm always willing to teach if you're willing to learn.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I happen to have some fermented dough here. Let's make a huge cookie, okay?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: How big do you want it to be?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Help me clear the workspace. I'll get the fire going.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Did you wash your hands, Kay?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Just try it and see. I'll let you know if you're doing it wrong.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Don't be afraid to crush it, put some force into it.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Knead it for a few more minutes.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Alright, that should be enough. Spread it on the board.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Cut it in half with the knife.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Then press each half into a circle.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: We won't use any stuffing this time. I'll teach you how to prepare the stuffing and how to make pies when you're better at this.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You missed a spot here, yes, here.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Take the dough on the board and put it into the oven.  Use these mitts for safety.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: On the rack in the oven?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: What else do I need to do?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's time to take the cookie out.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Just place it on the table and it's done.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: (Ceobe breaks off a piece and chews it)

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Cookies are best when they're still hot.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I have to give this to Little Cub quickly.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll put it between these wooden boards, so it'll stay warm longer.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: I'll guide you this time, but you have to go by yourself next time, got it?
Come in, the door is open!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I ate your cookie earlier, so I got you a new one.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Vulcan taught me how to make it. It's fresh outta the oven.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Hurry up and eat it before it gets cold.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You don't have to thank me.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Learn to do it well and you can make cookies by yourself next time.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Who knows, you might even be able to make your own honey biscuits one day.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: But I think I'd still eat your honey biscuits, Vulcan  !

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Let's go back. We can't leave the fire alone for too long.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Besides, you haven't finished eating the other cookie yet.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I was in such a rush to bring the cookie to Little Cub, I forgot my own.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That kind of cookie is fine for filling your stomach, but it still lacks a little something to make it really delicious.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Do you remember the meat sauce from last time?

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Want to dip your cookie in it?
